scope: Ten sample validation comparisons and three full-data, independently verified competition submissions after code review

data_fingerprint_measurement.measurement: One local pass, filesystem cache and concurrent workload not controlled; this measures metadata recording, not total model training speed.

engineering.interpretation: Replacing mandatory raw-file SHA-256 scans avoids rereading 1.377 GB for metadata provenance. This one uncontrolled local measurement is not an estimate of total model training speedup. Submission validation and content hashes remain.

interpretation.recommendation_basis: Preferences improve the matched random holdout. The current graph and full self-count variants reduce its AUC. Frequency variants tie, and past platform evidence showed frequency features can hurt despite better random-holdout AUC.
interpretation.row_order_and_tail: These evaluate different holdout rows; do not interpret their AUC differences from random holdout as feature gains or losses.
interpretation.numeric_comparison: The calendar variant jointly changes continuous-day date encoding and the ISRC reference-year proxy; the small difference cannot be attributed to either change individually.
interpretation.timing: Runs are sequential on one Kaggle CPU session. Total seconds include loading, feature building, validation training and serialization; differences include cache and runtime variation. With no-refit, final_training_seconds measures export rather than a second model fit.
interpretation.source_provenance: The source manifest records exact executed source hashes. The listed base commit alone does not reproduce these uncommitted changes.
limitations: One seed and one sampled training set
Early stopping and comparison use the same validation set
No platform gain is claimed from these sample scores
No repeated or controlled timing benchmark of the complete old and new pipelines
interpretation.sample_selected_full_candidate: calendar plus user context plus user preferences, leave-one-out counts, no frequency or graph features
interpretation.full_data_follow_up: The sample-selected preference candidate improved matched full-data random-holdout AUC by 0.00966753, but its Public/Private scores fell by 0.00336/0.00276 relative to calendar_full. Do not replace calendar_full with this preference model. Random-holdout improvements did not carry over to the competition partitions.

comparison_with_previous_context_full.scope: Joint continuous-day and ISRC reference-year proxy correction; engineering code was also simplified. The tiny local AUC difference is not evidence of a meaningful gain or loss.
comparison_with_previous_context_full.platform_conclusion: Public AUC improved by 0.00058; Private AUC is unchanged at the displayed precision. This is not evidence of an improvement on both partitions.

platform_submission.description: CS4304 calendar correction: 7377418 rows, context LOO, 30 features, 400 rounds

limitations: Training time is not controlled for host load or filesystem cache
No historical leaderboard rank is inferred

comparison_with_calendar_full.scope: Adds two training-only smoothed user artist and user genre probabilities to the calendar model; both use leave-one-out context counting, identical random holdout, no frequency or graph features, and matching LightGBM parameters.
comparison_with_calendar_full.platform_conclusion: Public AUC difference: -0.00336; Private AUC difference: -0.00276. Differences use the platform's displayed precision; statistical significance was not tested.

platform_submission.description: CS4304 full preferences: 7377418 rows, calendar/context LOO, 32 features, 400 rounds

limitations: Training time is not controlled for host load or filesystem cache
No historical leaderboard rank is inferred
full_data_experiments.selection_decision: Retain calendar_full over preferences_full: the preference model scores lower on both competition partitions. This does not rule out other preference definitions or validation strategies.

platform_submission.description: CS4304 row-order validation: full preferences, calendar, leaves127, 304 rounds

comparison_with_calendar_full.scope: Combined change: user preferences, row-order holdout, learning rate 0.05, 127 leaves, minimum leaf samples 200, categorical threshold 64, feature fraction 0.8, maximum 1000 rounds. Early stopping selected 304 rounds, then refit all rows.
comparison_with_calendar_full.conclusion: Neither platform score exceeds calendar_full. Different holdout and parameters prevent attributing this outcome to row-order validation alone.

limitations: Combined changes rather than an isolated split ablation
Validation AUC is not directly comparable with random holdout
Single-run timing does not control host load
No historical leaderboard rank is inferred
full_data_experiments.selection_decision: Keep calendar_full as the current preferred platform model; row-order remains available for more realistic holdout diagnostics.

current_platform_selection.comparison_with_previous_best: Public +0.00058; Private unchanged at displayed precision. Preference and combined row-order/capacity experiments did not improve either score.
